title: Active Curiosity as Uncertainty-Reduction Policy
hypothesis: Selecting experiments by estimated information gain per unit cost reaches fixed predictive accuracy with at least 30% fewer queries than random selection or preregistered novelty heuristics.
falsification_criteria: Query reduction fails across held-out environment families, or LLM-estimated information gain fails to correlate with realized uncertainty reduction.

projected_impact.basis: Declared 2026-11-04 by claude-code (MISSION-031 backfill) from the mission's hypothesis; a mission always also edits its own manifest. Refine at checkout and confirm with `manage_coordination.py verify`.
